evidence.note: CONFLICT_PROBE_FAILED writes probeFailed true with conflict unknown and reason probe-failed; CONFLICT_NOT_LIVE, CONFLICT_CLEAN, and the exit-1 conflict object all write probeFailed false.
mergeTreeDerivation maps exit 0/1/other onto clean/conflict/probe-failed. probeFailed is true iff conflictReason is probe-failed; not-live keeps a reason without the flag.

notes: Declared domain is boolean times FleetConflictStatus (3) times NullOr FleetUnknownReason (5). Supported constructors are not-live, probe-failed, clean, and conflict. Conflict paths stay a required array on the conflict arm.

disqualifier.note: Concrete Reflect.defineProperty descriptor at attachCsvColumns. configurable, enumerable, and writable are the ECMAScript property-descriptor contract; this call pins true/true/false to attach a columns array.
